feature_contract.goal: Restore the complete game driving speed/time/position HUD under asymmetric Quest 3 eye FOV, keeping enlarged legible peripheral groups inside both eye safe rectangles and native world/stereo source unchanged.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original-game producer-tagged peripheral driving HUD XYZRHW draws. Do not touch GOAL, stage +TIME, F11, ESC, main menu, world billboards, lens flare, SkyGlow or FFB.
trace_stages: Canonical original 0xBA9D0 producer classifies gear/REV/rank/time in src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp and queues matching SpriteNode token.
R30GetExactHudEdgeAnchor reads actual primitive source bounds; R30AdaptivePeripheralHudBoost evaluates bilateral FOV-safe scale and R30TransformXyzrhwStereo writes both eyes.
R29 latches original desktop viewport and XR published FOV/eye extent; two scaled draws flow through DX9Ex eye submission to host composition.
subcomponents: Keep original full draw visible when optical FOV offsets make the existing 0.90x perimeter text enlargement infeasible for both eyes; calculate largest safe 1.0x-to-baseline shared scale.
Preserve larger readable scale when both-eye bounds fit; block unknown/GOAL/centre HUD, invalid geometry and desktop/global HUD paths.
Validate source-space 4:3 16:9 21:9 and asymmetric two-eye negative mutations; run full exact-SHA game/host/package and domain CI independently of Quest3 hardware.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All original eligible enlarged driving HUD glyphs stay inside both-eye safe bounds when a common translation and safe boost exist.
Offscreen/unknown/GOAL/centre and impossible FOV fallback retain safe original behaviour; ordinary feasible 0.90x HUD remains legible.
Required exact-SHA DX9Ex Active Win32 host/game/package and Domain Isolation/Source Impact gates pass, without treating CI as HMD optical evidence.

diagnosis.original_evidence: At ultrawide desktop to Quest portrait eye scales, baseline 0.90x source glyph enlargement can exceed shared visible safe bounds when left/right FOV offsets diverge; prior branch returned known-unfit previousBoost.
source_trace: EXE original text caller stamps OutRunHudPeripheralText exact class through 0xBA9D0.
R30 exact group bbox and boosted X/Y eye transforms flow to screen space.
Both XR eyes require a single common horizontal shift inside safety insets; old prior boost check did not reduce scale.
diagnosis.root_cause: If fitsBothEyes(previousBoost) was false, R30AdaptivePeripheralHudBoost returned the same previousBoost, causing predictable letter clipping, and desired<=previousBoost bypassed all feasibility checks.
alternatives_rejected: Changing VRHudScale globally would also shrink F11/ESC/GOAL and world paths.
Clamping each eye independently would alter binocular disparity.
Changing the original game timer or Quest host eye extent would not repair source primitive fit.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Exact R30 peripheral HUD scope only; no world/flare/GOAL, both eyes keep shared displacement, and source/boundaries come from original latched viewport.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The source uses a bounded 10-step 1x-to-previous scale search only when original boosted geometry cannot fit both eyes, preserving pre-existing affine FOV path and 1x fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extend the existing R30 responsive HUD anchor CI with 4:3/16:9/21:9 stereo eye-offset numerical fixtures, unfit-boost recovery and four destructive source mutations.

runtime_gate: Requires matching Quest3/VDXR frame capture for speed/time/position all visible, edge safety, readable 4:3/16:9/21:9 and Reset. HMD not run.
hold_resolution: C6 exact-SHA required GitHub Actions SUCCESS; bookkeeping only; no re-run
